markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 16"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Cratering Drop](/Feats.aspx?ID=5540) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 83

**Archetype** [Winged Warrior](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=227)

**Prerequisites**
[Winged Warrior Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5527); [Pluck From the Sky](/Feats.aspx?ID=5533)

**Requirements**
Your previous action was Pluck from the Skies, and the target failed or critically failed their saving throw.

</column>

---

You follow up your enemy's fall, driving you both to the earth in a meteoric descent. You [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) straight down, increasing the amount the enemy falls by your Fly speed. If you reach the ground, you drive the enemy into the ground, dealing double the normal [falling damage](/Rules.aspx?ID=402).
